pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i-7 8700 3.2Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows 10 compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i-9 9900K 3.6Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows 11 compatible sound card

short_description: A fast paced sci-fi shooter with tons of enemies, weapons and secrets to unlock. Will you survive the onslaught?
